description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincially operated retail liquor outlet in Chilliwack, offering a wide selection of wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders under the BC Government's retail brand. As one of over 200 locations across the province, this Sumas Way store gives touring cyclists a convenient stop to pick up cold beverages or supplies for an evening camp. The store is part of a well-recognized Crown corporation chain with consistent product availability.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 73m; wall_loops (8 spaces) at 85m. Total: 12 spaces.
